title: Northern Lights In Sweden With Dinner On The Ice
overview: About the Tour: Spent a few days in Swedish Lapland at the Brndön Lodge, which is known for its exceptional hospitality. The lodge, which overlooks the Lule archipelago's frozen waters, is the perfect backdrop for an exciting dog sled safari and a memorable al fresco lunch on the ice. Continuing your journey by train, you'll travel deep into the breathtaking winter wilderness to Camp Ripan, where north-facing lodgings offer some of the region's best potential Aurora Borealis views. Then it's on to Abisko National Park, which is home to the world-famous Abisko Sky Station, which is situated high on the slopes of Mount Nuolja and is one of the best spots on the planet to see the magnificent Northern Lights. Your tour will culminate in a fascinating night at the unique Ice Hotel, where you will learn from an expert how to best capture these stunning displays on camera.You can celebrate the end of your voyage with a drink from the famed Ice Bar while spending your final evening in a room carved from the ice of the Torne River.

days.title: Lulea - Brandon Lodge
prose: You will be transferred along the Swedish coast to the Brandön Lodge, which is situated on a small island with views of the icy seas of the Lule archipelago
Dinner will be provided in the lodge's main restaurant after you've been greeted by your hosts, and there may be time to do some stargazing and aurora viewing on the way back to your cabin

days.title: Husky Safari And Dinner On Ice
prose: After breakfast, you'll be driven to a neighbouring kennel to meet your husky team
When you're ready, your dog-sled safari departs at a leisurely pace, travelling forested trails through magnificent countryside before returning to the resort for a relaxing afternoon

days.title: Northern Lights Safari
prose: This evening, your experience continues with a snowshoe trek out into the local countryside, after a relaxed day enjoying some of the myriad activities available from the lodge
Away from the lodge's lights, these landscapes provide the perfect backdrop for some outstanding Northern Lights displays

days.title: Brandon Lodge - Camp Ripan
prose: Your travel today will take you deep into the heart of Swedish Lapland, as you move towards the fell and forest beauty around Kiruna, which you will reach by train this morning
After a four-and-a-half-hour journey, you will be taken to Camp Ripan, where you will be treated to a superb three-course meal and the opportunity to rest in the newly created Aurora Spa

days.title: Camp Ripan - Abisko
prose: Continuing your rail adventure today, you will travel to Abisko National Park, which is located near the Norwegian border and has a stunning environment
The Abisko Mountain Lodge is located in a region known for its Northern Lights activity, and your arrival transfer will take you through some of the most breathtaking scenery conceivable

days.title: Abisko - Ice Hotel
prose: Your first trip this morning, after breakfast, will be at Nutti Sámi Siida, a tiny museum and cultural exhibit dedicated to the Sámi people's traditions and heritage. Moving on, your next visit will be a dramatic contrast to the Sámi's traditional building, as you make your way to the Ice Hotel's distinctive environment

days.title: Ice Hotel - Kiruna Airport
prose: This morning, go to the Kiruna airport for your return flight
You can have your breakfast at the hotel and get ready for the return flight
You will then complete all the check out formalities and our agents will help you with the transfer to the airport
